Consider the diagram shown above, where QP→=a, RQ→=b, SQ→=c, and RT→=d. Find TP→ in terms of a,b,c, and d.

a
TP→=a+b−c
b
TP→=a−c+d
c
TP→=a+b−d
d
TP→=a−b+d
e
TP→=b−c−d
